## Statement

$$ \forall n \in \mathbb{Z},\; n^2 > n $$

## Hypotheses

- **H1.** $n$ ranges over the integers.

## Why it was raised

A refuted entry, so the fixture exercises the counterexample contract.

## Current notes

Refuted at $n = 1$.
